errors.smimeDecryptFailed: The S/MIME message could not be decrypted.
errors.smimeDecodeFailed: The decrypted S/MIME content could not be read.
errors.smimeNestingLimit: The S/MIME message has too many nested layers.
errors.smimeRemainingEncryption: The S/MIME message contains another encrypted layer that could not be opened.
errors.smimeMalformedSigned: The S/MIME signature structure is incomplete or malformed.
errors.smimeMalformedMime: The decrypted S/MIME content has an incomplete or malformed MIME structure.
errors.smimeUndecodedPart: The decrypted S/MIME content contains a part that Satchel cannot show.
errors.smimeVerificationFailed: The S/MIME signature could not be verified.
errors.pgpSeveralEncryptedBlocks: The message contains several OpenPGP blocks. Satchel decrypts only messages with a single encrypted block.
errors.pgpDecodeFailed: The decrypted OpenPGP content could not be read.
errors.pgpNestingLimit: The decrypted OpenPGP content has too many nested layers.
errors.pgpRemainingEncryption: The decrypted OpenPGP content contains another encrypted layer that could not be opened.
errors.pgpMalformedSigned: The signature structure in the decrypted OpenPGP content is incomplete or malformed.
errors.pgpMalformedMime: The decrypted OpenPGP content has an incomplete or malformed MIME structure.
errors.pgpUndecodedPart: The decrypted OpenPGP content contains a part that Satchel cannot show.
errors.decryptedAttachmentUnavailable: This attachment comes from an encrypted message, and its decrypted copy is no longer stored. Open the message to decrypt it again.
